intro: If Sri Lanka has been on your list, consider this your sign. Tea hills, ancient cities and southern beaches, all within reach of a short holiday.

sections.heading: Why visit Sri Lanka
paragraphs: Sri Lanka (South Asia) is known for its beach, heritage and nature experiences. Overall it is mid-range — comfortable stays and good food without overspending.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is December to March for the south and west coasts.

sections.heading: How to get there
paragraphs: Short direct flights from Chennai, Delhi, Mumbai and other cities to Colombo.

sections.heading: Insider tip
paragraphs: Reserve the Kandy–Ella train seats early, or try the unreserved carriage for the view.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Sri Lanka?
faq.a: December to March for the south and west coasts.

faq.q: How do I reach Sri Lanka?
faq.a: Short direct flights from Chennai, Delhi, Mumbai and other cities to Colombo.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Sri Lanka?
faq.a: Popular choices: Galle / Mirissa for beaches; Ella for hills; Kandy for culture.
